title.narrative: Promoting Media and Information Literacy in Bangladesh

description.narrative: The awareness and advocacy work plan for Media and Information Literacy (MIL) in Bangladesh addresses the urgent need to enhance MIL skills among media organizations, journalists, educational institutions, youth groups, civil society organizations involving relevant government bodies and UN agencies. The focus will be on solution-oriented actions to tackle disinformation, hate speech, and racism, while promoting freedoms, gender equality, and peacebuilding. Collaboration with stakeholders will facilitate the regular celebration of Global Media and Information Literacy Week. This plan aims to empower journalists to critically evaluate media content and foster an informed society by promoting MIL awareness and advocating its importance. Leveraging the digital revolution, the vision includes transforming targeted cities into "MIL Cities," aligning with Bangladesh's Smart Bangladesh Vision 2041, which emphasizes the development of Smart Citizens, Smart Government, Smart Economy, and Smart Society.
